purpose: Track ETMOD (SOUTHMOD Ethiopia) model findings observed in household-level Axiom oracle comparisons, mirroring ghamod_issues.json and microzamod_issues.json. Canonical narrative ledger: rulespec-et#1 closing comment.

entries.summary: ETMOD implements the Proclamation 1395/2025 Article 23 Minimum Alternative Tax as an addition: when scheduled business tax falls below 2.5% of turnover it ADDS the full 2.5% of turnover to tin02_s (Output_Add_Var), where sub-article 3 provides the minimum tax 'shall be reduced by business income tax under Article 18 paid in the tax year' - a floor. Probed live: at 3,000,000 birr receipts and 60,000 taxable income ETMOD returns tin02_s 81,000 (= scheduled 6,000 + 75,000) where the statutory payable is 75,000. The encoded rulespec-et module implements the reduced top-up; the et-business-mat suite runs the MAT-dormant agreement zone.

ETMOD levies the Article 23 minimum tax on taxpayers under the Article 49 total gross revenue tax regime (Category B, annual gross receipts at or below Birr 2,000,000), whom sub-article 4 expressly excludes: 'This Article shall not apply to a taxpayer under the total gross revenue tax regime set out in Article 49 of this Proclamation.' Probed live: at 50,000 birr receipts ETMOD returns tin02_s 1,250 (= 2.5% of receipts) alongside the presumptive ttn_s 1,000, double-taxing every presumptive-regime business. The encoded module gates the minimum tax to receipts above the Category A bound.
